moa.t: Binds the 30S ribosomal subunit, retains activity against many gentamicin-resistant Gram-negatives

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Amikacin, IV, 15 mg/kg daily. (See Appendix II, for individual dosing and monitoring for response and toxicity.)
Amikacin, IV, 15 mg/kg daily for 7 days. OR If local resistance patterns show low level resistance to ciprofloxacin or culture
Amikacin, IV, 15 mg/kg daily given slowly over 30 minutes. · If BMI is >40 kg/m2 use ideal body weight* + 40% of the difference between ideal and actual body weight.
Amikacin, IV, 15 mg/kg/dose, daily. Adjust therapy according to sensitivities. Reconsider empirical antibiotic therapy and duration of therapy daily.
Amikacin, IV, for 7 days. · 15 mg/kg/dose 24 hourly. · Therapeutic drug monitoring to be done where available.

cautions.t: Extend the interval in renal impairment
Avoid other nephrotoxic or ototoxic drugs

monitoring.t: Renal function, audiometry on longer courses, levels where available
